title: Frontend: Multiselect dropdown
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Multiselect dropdown. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({options=[Apple,Banana,Cherry]}). Controlled Search options combobox filters case-insensitively and opens a listbox #choices. Buttons role=option display matches; empty matches show No options. Click toggles selection, retains hidden choices and keeps popup open. Display selected labels comma-joined in insertion order. Output is [data-testid=selected]. Escape closes without clearing selection; ArrowDown advances highlight and Enter selects it.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Store selection by option ID and keep query/highlight state separate.
alternativeApproaches: Support remote option loading without discarding selected IDs that are absent from a particular response.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Hidden selected option; disabled option; maximum count.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
